title: design-delta decisions file
description: The owner's answers that ask for a change rather than an exemption (`fix-code`, `change-contract`, `change-design`), written by `design-delta decide` at `paths.decisionsFile` for the resolve skill to act on. `accept`, `waive` and `track` answers are never here: they are `exemptions` entries in the config. An entry stays until every finding it names is gone, then the next `decide` run reports it done and removes it.

id.description: The decision's id when it was answered.

entities.description: The entities the answer covers, as the findings name them.

note.description: What the owner wants done, in their words.
